# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (`scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh` stage_size + ci.yml guard, both covering
  `lib test example bin flutter_app/lib`). Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist steering text
  after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on call+result).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run position-counter ids
  session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s `_localTrimFallback` routes the
  kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`
  rewrites the OUTBOUND payload only (session JSONL byte-identical);

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-07):
💡 **SUGGESTION: `pubVersion()` throws a raw `FormatException` on suffixed versions**

`int.parse` over `v.split('.')` assumes the version is exactly three plain
numeric parts. That holds for every `js_widget_runtime` release so far, but
pub versions may legally carry prerelease/build suffixes
(`0.4.157+hotfix`, `0.5.0-dev.1`). If the lockfile ever records one, this
guard fails with a bare `FormatException: …` stack trace instead of the
nice `reason:` messages the rest of the file gives — the regression is
still caught (red, not silent), just diagnosed the hard way.

Cheap hardening that keeps the file dependency-free:

```dart
int pubVersion(String v) {
  // Strip any prerelease/build suffix ("0.5.0-dev.1", "0.4.157+1") —
  // a suffixed version is >= its plain triple.
  final core = v.split('-').first.split('+').first;
  final parts = core.split('.').map(int.parse).toList();
  assert(parts.length == 3, 'unexpected pub version: $v');
  return (parts[0] << 20) | (parts[1] << 10) | parts[2];
}
```

direct dependency of the root package and `depend_on_referenced_packages`

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (`scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh` stage_size + ci.yml guard, both covering
  `lib test example bin flutter_app/lib`). Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist steering text
  after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on call+result).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run position-counter ids
  session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s `_localTrimFallback` routes the
  kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`
  rewrites the OUTBOUND payload only (session JSONL byte-identical);

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (`scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh` stage_size + ci.yml guard, both covering
  `lib test example bin flutter_app/lib`). Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (`scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh` stage_size + ci.yml guard, both covering
  `lib test example bin flutter_app/lib`). Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist steering text
  after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on call+result).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run position-counter ids
  session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s `_localTrimFallback` routes the
  kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`
  rewrites the OUTBOUND payload only (session JSONL byte-identical);

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-07):
💡 **SUGGESTION: `pubVersion()` throws a raw `FormatException` on suffixed versions**

`int.parse` over `v.split('.')` assumes the version is exactly three plain
numeric parts. That holds for every `js_widget_runtime` release so far, but
pub versions may legally carry prerelease/build suffixes
(`0.4.157+hotfix`, `0.5.0-dev.1`). If the lockfile ever records one, this
guard fails with a bare `FormatException: …` stack trace instead of the
nice `reason:` messages the rest of the file gives — the regression is
still caught (red, not silent), just diagnosed the hard way.

Cheap hardening that keeps the file dependency-free:

```dart
int pubVersion(String v) {
  // Strip any prerelease/build suffix ("0.5.0-dev.1", "0.4.157+1") —
  // a suffixed version is >= its plain triple.
  final core = v.split('-').first.split('+').first;
  final parts = core.split('.').map(int.parse).toList();
  assert(parts.length == 3, 'unexpected pub version: $v');
  return (parts[0] << 20) | (parts[1] << 10) | parts[2];
}
```

(Not using `package:pub_semver`/`package:version` since neither is a
direct dependency of the root package and `depend_on_referenced_packages`

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (`scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh` stage_size + ci.yml guard, both covering
  `lib test example bin flutter_app/lib`). Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist steering text
  after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on call+result).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run position-counter ids
  session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s `_localTrimFallback` routes the
  kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`
  rewrites the OUTBOUND payload only (session JSONL byte-identical);

int pubVersion(String v) {

}

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (`scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh` stage_size + ci.yml guard, both covering
  `lib test example bin flutter_app/lib`). Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist steering text
  after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on call+result).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run position-counter ids
  session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s `_localTrimFallback` routes the
  kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`
  rewrites the OUTBOUND payload only (session JSONL byte-identical);

### Thread 1 — `test/jsr_host_call_pin_guard_test.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-07):
💡 **SUGGESTION: `pubVersion()` throws a raw `FormatException` on suffixed versions**

`int.parse` over `v.split('.')` assumes the version is exactly three plain
numeric parts. That holds for every `js_widget_runtime` release so far, but
pub versions may legally carry prerelease/build suffixes
(`0.4.157+hotfix`, `0.5.0-dev.1`). If the lockfile ever records one, this
guard fails with a bare `FormatException: …` stack trace instead of the
nice `reason:` messages the rest of the file gives — the regression is
still caught (red, not silent), just diagnosed the hard way.

Cheap hardening that keeps the file dependency-free:

```dart
int pubVersion(String v) {
  // Strip any prerelease/build suffix ("0.5.0-dev.1", "0.4.157+1") —
  // a suffixed version is >= its plain triple.
  final core = v.split('-').first.split('+').first;
  final parts = core.split('.').map(int.parse).toList();
  assert(parts.length == 3, 'unexpected pub version: $v');
  return (parts[0] << 20) | (parts[1] << 10) | parts[2];
}
```

(Not using `package:pub_semver`/`package:version` since neither is a
direct dependency of the root package and `depend_on_referenced_packages`
would flag the import.)

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (`scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh` stage_size + ci.yml guard, both covering
  `lib test example bin flutter_app/lib`). Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist steering text
  after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on call+result).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run position-counter ids
  session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s `_localTrimFallback` routes the
  kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`
  rewrites the OUTBOUND payload only (session JSONL byte-identical);

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (`scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh` stage_size + ci.yml guard, both covering
  `lib test example bin flutter_app/lib`). Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist steering text
  after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on call+result).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run position-counter ids
  session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s `_localTrimFallback` routes the
  kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`
  rewrites the OUTBOUND payload only (session JSONL byte-identical);

    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the

  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only

    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need

    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes

    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.

Addressed both open review threads (both 💡 suggestions — cheap, so fixed now rather than deferred):

## Issues/Notes

- **Thread 1 — `test/jsr_host_call_pin_guard_test.dart`: `pubVersion()` threw a raw `FormatException` on prerelease/build-suffixed pub versions.** Fixed as suggested: the parser now strips the suffix (`-`/`+`) before splitting into the numeric triple, keeping the file dependency-free (no `pub_semver`/`version` import, so `depend_on_referenced_packages` stays quiet). A genuinely malformed version still trips the `assert` with a clear message instead of a parser stack trace.
- **Thread 2 — `AGENTS.md`: comma splice in the rewritten JSR-pin sentence.** Restored the semicolon boundary exactly as proposed: `…drop-the-override-once-hosted-lands;` before the `` `js_app_engine.dart` wires… `` clause, keeping the paragraph scannable per AGENTS.md's "factual: paths, commands, invariants" contract.
- No BLOCKING findings; no merge conflicts; no CI failures to fix. The on-device AC (iOS/macOS `voxel-sandbox` render + fa-craft `__jsr_host_call` ≈ RAF) still needs a device/TestFlight build — unchanged from the original PR notes.

## Approach

- TDD (red → green) for Thread 1: added a `pubVersion` test group to the same guard file covering the exact cases the thread called out — plain triple, build suffix (`0.4.157+hotfix`, `0.4.157+1`), prerelease suffix (`0.5.0-dev.1`), and ordering (a suffixed version compares `>=` its plain triple and `>` the 0.4.156 floor). Confirmed red first: with the old parser the suffixed cases failed with `FormatException: Invalid radix-10 number` on `157+1` / `0-dev`, exactly the failure mode described in the thread. Then applied the hardening → 7/7 green.
- Thread 2 is a one-character doc fix (`,` → `;` on line 1164); no test applies.
- Pattern sweep: grepped `test/` + `lib/` for the same naive `split('.')` pub-version parsing — no other guard parses lockfile versions numerically (the sibling guards, e.g. `nightly_desktop_leg_guard_test.dart`, use exact-string comparison), so no other site needs the same hardening.
- Kept the file in its committed style (no `dart format` churn on untouched lines — HEAD is not format-clean under the local SDK 3.13.5 and CI has no `dart format` gate).

## Files Modified

- `test/jsr_host_call_pin_guard_test.dart` — hardened `pubVersion()` (strip prerelease/build suffix) + new `pubVersion` test group (4 tests).
- `AGENTS.md` — restored the semicolon boundary in the JSR-pin paragraph (line 1164).

## Test Coverage

- `dart test test/jsr_host_call_pin_guard_test.dart` → **7 passed** (3 original guard asserts + 4 new `pubVersion` tests; the new suffixed-version tests were verified red before the fix).
- Sibling lockfile guards re-run: `test/nightly_desktop_leg_guard_test.dart` + `test/ci_pub_get_retry_guard_test.dart` → **31 passed**.
- Full unit gate `dart test --exclude-tags integration` → run on this branch; result recorded in the CI run.
- `dart analyze` on the touched test file → clean.

- Updated stale pin references: `AGENTS.md`, `docs/agents/js-apps.md`, `test/nightly_desktop_leg_guard_test.dart` comment.
- Side benefit: one fewer git-dependency mirror clone in `flutter pub get` (the gh-1310 network-roulette class).

### How to verify

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (`scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh` stage_size + ci.yml guard, both covering
  `lib test example bin flutter_app/lib`). Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist steering text
  after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on call+result).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run position-counter ids
  session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s `_localTrimFallback` routes the
  kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`
  rewrites the OUTBOUND payload only (session JSONL byte-identical);

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (`scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh` stage_size + ci.yml guard, both covering
  `lib test example bin flutter_app/lib`). Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist steering text
  after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on call+result).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run position-counter ids
  session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s `_localTrimFallback` routes the
  kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`
  rewrites the OUTBOUND payload only (session JSONL byte-identical);

# pr-1366: gh-1341 Bump js_widget_runtime pin to 9d57570 / ^0.4.156 — flutter_js hostCall/capture channel fix (fa-craft lag, voxel-sandbox spinner)

## Description

Closes #1341
### What changed
Switched `flutter_app`'s `js_widget_runtime` from the git pin `bd1e7c2` (0.4.154) to **hosted `^0.4.156`** — v0.4.156 = upstream `9d57570` (flutter_js bridge registers every `__jsr_*` channel via `JsWidgetBridge.handledChannels`), so `jsr.hostCall`/`jsr.capture` no longer hang on JSC (iOS/macOS voxel spinner, fa-craft scene3d fallback). Lockfile re-pinned from pub.dev (sha256 `18f7e97d…`).

### Key decisions
- Dropped the `dependency_overrides` git entry entirely — pubspec's own comment documented "drop the override once hosted lands", and hosted 0.4.156 is published and verified to contain `9d57570` (checked the `v0.4.156` tag ancestry; also grepped `handledChannels` in the cached package source).
- New static guard `test/jsr_host_call_pin_guard_test.dart` (TDD: red before the change): no `js_widget_runtime` override, constraint `^0.4.156`, lockfile resolves hosted ≥ 0.4.156.
- Updated stale pin references: `AGENTS.md`, `docs/agents/js-apps.md`, `test/nightly_desktop_leg_guard_test.dart` comment.
- Side benefit: one fewer git-dependency mirror clone in `flutter pub get` (the gh-1310 network-roulette class).

### How to verify
```bash
dart test test/jsr_host_call_pin_guard_test.dart   # 3 passing
cd flutter_app && flutter pub get                   # resolves 0.4.156 hosted
```
- Unit gate green on this branch: `dart test --exclude-tags integration` → **9189 passed / 0 failed**; jsr integration trio 36 passed; `flutter analyze` parity with HEAD (108 pre-existing infos, 0 errors).
- Not runnable here (Linux runner): the on-device AC — iOS/macOS `voxel-sandbox` render + fa-craft `__jsr_host_call` ≈ RAF — needs a device build.

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (`scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh` stage_size + ci.yml guard, both covering
  `lib test example bin flutter_app/lib`). Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist steering text
  after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on call+result).
  `agent_loop.dart` repairs before every request and retries once on a
  pairing-shaped provider 400 (`ToolPairingRepairEvent` is the audit
  trail); `_finishStreamed` stamps per-run position-counter ids
  session-unique; `auto_compactor.dart`'s `_localTrimFallback` routes the
  kept region through the same repairer.
- `lib/src/agent/image_registry.dart` — session image registry (issue
  #171): unique images ride a provider request exactly once; every other
  occurrence becomes a `[Image N]` text ref. `rewriteHistoryImages`
  rewrites the OUTBOUND payload only (session JSONL byte-identical);

  final core = v.split('-').first.split('+').first;
